fact: The document is the national statistics strategy ENDE 2025-2029, the third for the Sistema Estatistico Nacional, presented as the one to be implemented; it states no adoption date, so the year is the document's published date (2025).
The ENDE 2018-2021 was a national statistics strategy that ended in 2021; no successor was drawn up immediately, and some of its activities continued ad hoc until 2024.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2018-2021.
